scope: Current-build GUI and public MCP Split parity on five pinned small and wide radius inputs; not complete native or M2 acceptance.
buildProvenance: The build was produced at e10f32a8; e4d61253 changes only tests, fixtures and acceptance documentation, not application or build source.
method: Isolated Chrome and public MCP bridge with pinned STL imports in millimetres and no import placement; GUI and MCP Split geometry and metadata comparison, history, binary project reopen, MCP held-result cancellation and GUI close cancellation. Browser plugin was unavailable in this session; the retained Playwright driver used independent loopback ports.
result: All five application GUI/MCP comparisons passed, with no page errors and owned processes and ports cleaned up. The shared-operation native facet tests separately identify four expected mismatches; wide-above matches the retained native unordered Float32 facet multiset.
limitations: The archived driver must be copied into the checkout tests directory to resolve its relative paths.
The retained native viewport was white; the comparison uses exported STL and ignores facet winding and native seam identity.
These are bounded cases, not a general native or lifecycle guarantee. Four native facet mismatches and the rotated mismatch remain open.
